rationale: Missing or expired passive offer is terminal and never opens.
A live passive offer opens only when gameplay is not in combat and no screen is active.
The already-open matching modal keeps component and protocol identity.
Combat defers the authoritative domain-store offer and emits at most one notification per identity.
Another screen defers the authoritative domain-store offer until currentScreen becomes null.
TTL expiry settles the offer instead of replaying it later.
An immediate user keypress may open when no screen blocks it.
A matching screen is not recreated.
Physical keypresses are never queued for future replay.
Insight may replace ordinary non-modal UI through transition arbitration.
The same insight offer is not reopened.
Insight waits behind equal or higher modal UI.
Insight never displaces death or termination UI.
Death or termination may displace lower-priority UI.
